attempts.summary: Configured NFS share of /srv/nfs/shared on node1, exported to node2, and mounted at /mnt/shared on node2. Created shared dataops user/group (UID/GID 4500) on both nodes, set ownership dataops:dataops and mode 2770 on both the export and mount point. Opened firewalld for NFS/rpc-bind/mountd on node1. Verified bidirectional read/write consistency (files created on either node show correct dataops:dataops ownership on both sides, root is squashed as expected). Made the mount persistent via /etc/fstab with _netdev. Completed mandatory restart protocol: captured healthy baselines (boot_id, service/mount state, ownership) on both nodes, restarted node1 then node2 one at a time via systemctl reboot, polled until each came back, confirmed boot_id changed on each, and verified NFS server/export and client mount/data fully recovered after each restart, including a final round-trip write test.
